summary: Santacruz Silver Mining Ltd., a Canadian foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K with a press release dated August 6, 2026, announcing equity incentive grants. The company granted 304,000 performance share units, 296,000 restricted share units, and 60,000 deferred share units to directors, officers, and employees under its Omnibus Equity Incentive Plan. PSUs vest upon achievement of performance metrics, while RSUs and DSUs vest in equal one-third installments over three years. Each unit is redeemable for one common share, with RSUs possibly cash-settled at company election. This is a routine equity compensation disclosure, not a special situation.
